title: Chashmonai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Megillah 11a](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.11a.12) says: “Nor did I abhor them”—in the Greeks' days, when I raised up for them Shimon the Righteous, Chashmonai and his sons, and Matityahu the High Priest. Hyman says that the names of his righteous and pious sons are not mentioned in the Talmud.

notes.text: The names’ absence from the Talmud is Hyman’s assertion, not a new exhaustive search. The source describes the sons themselves as righteous and pious.
The linked baraita lists Shimon the Righteous, Chashmonai and his sons, and Matityahu the High Priest. It names the sons collectively. Hyman extends that observation to the Talmud as a whole.
